tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description:
Search the VistaLink hotel catalogue (650,000 hotels) in one city,
        a neighbourhood or landmark within it (area, e.g. city='Milan',
        area='Brera'), or around a point. Needs city, latitude+longitude, or
        hotel_name; describe the stay in vibe. Returns hotels with ratings,

tools.name: get_hotel_details
tools.description:
Full profile of one hotel by its hotel_id from search_hotels:
        description, amenities, images, rooms, guest reviews and guest
        insights. A price is included only when both check_in and check_out
        are given, as the all-inclusive total for that stay. parley_url is
        the hote
